component.name: BIMAX
component.summary: Explore jaw movements from a binary bone volume

description.p: BIMAX is a native Linux application for separating the upper and lower jaws in a binary bone volume, defining Le Fort, BSSO, and genioplasty cuts, and comparing movement scenarios in slice and 3D views.
It is a geometric simulation and does not predict fractures, bite, or soft-tissue behavior.
